setups.name: Model Knows
setups.why: We and Vegas pick different winners and our line has our team by 2+ points: back our team on the moneyline (judge it by the price just before tip, once lineups are in)
setups.note: 2020-21..2025-26 at the closing price: our team won 136-102 (57.1%) outright, +25% per bet on the moneyline; covered 145-91 (61.4%). The backtest knew who played, so judge it near tip. A real 1u bet since Nov 9 2026

setups.name: Combo watch
setups.why: One model weighing about 40 things we know by 11am (rest and travel, the standings, recent form and pace, our ratings, the line and how it has moved) flags the side it's most sure of; about 1 game in 20 qualifies
setups.note: Most confident 5% of games, walk-forward: 140-104 (57.4%), 36-25 in the 2025-26 exam (2022-23 was 30-31). Paper-tracked until Nov 8 2026; a real 0.5u bet since Nov 9 2026

setups.name: Vegas Knows
setups.why: Our line has the game within 4 points but Vegas has the favorite 3+ points bigger than we do: Vegas likely knows something we don't (injuries, lineups, a new roster). Bet the Vegas favorite on the moneyline, 1u risked at its price
setups.note: Moneyline only. 2020-21..2025-26: the Vegas favorite won 375-231 (61.9%) outright. Its typical price is -230, which needs about 70% to break even, so betting it lost about 11% per bet (it covered the spread only 45%). Bet at 1u since Nov 9 2026 by choice, to test it live: the backtest says it loses at these prices, so it gets 1 star

setups.name: Line Held
setups.why: Our simulator is 3+ points off the line toward one side, 60%+ of the betting tickets are on the other side, and the line has NOT moved toward the public since the opener: the book is holding its number. Bet our side
setups.note: BetMGM splits 2021-22..2025-26 (Feb), at the closing line: 20-15 (57%) overall, 13-4 in the last 3 seasons, but it lost money in 3 of the 4 earlier seasons and only ~8 games a season fit, so it did NOT pass our test. A live 0.5u test bet since Nov 11 2026 (owner's call)

setups.name: Follow the Move
setups.why: 60%+ of the betting tickets are on one side and the line has moved 1+ point toward that side since the opener. Books move lines on news and sharp money more than on public tickets, so the move is usually real: bet that side
setups.note: BetMGM splits 2021-22..2025-26 (Feb), at the closing line: 115-87 (56.9%), but 2023-24 broke even (18-18) and we only looked at this side after testing the opposite bet, so it did NOT pass our test. A live 0.5u test bet since Nov 11 2026 (owner's call)

setups.name: Reverse Line Move
setups.why: 65%+ of the betting tickets are on one side, yet the line has moved 0.5+ points AGAINST them since the opener (the book made the public's side cheaper). Books do that when sharp money or news is on the other side: bet against the public
setups.note: BetMGM splits 2021-22..2025-26 (Feb), at the closing line: 159-126 (55.8%); +8%, +17%, +20% in the last 3 seasons, but 2021-22 lost (12 bets) and 2022-23 broke even, and the pattern was found by looking at the data, so it did NOT pass our full test. A live 0.5u test since Nov 11 2026 (owner's call)

setups.name: Tired Traveler
setups.why: Away team on the 2nd night of a back-to-back AND it crossed a time zone since its last game (home team rested): bet the home team
setups.note: 178-143 (55.5%) at the morning line 2020-21..2025-26, every season 51%+

setups.name: Falling Total Over
setups.why: 75%+ of the betting tickets are on the over, yet the total has dropped (or held) since the opener. The market tends to lower NBA totals too far, usually on injury news: bet the over
setups.note: BetMGM splits 2021-22..2025-26 (Feb), at the closing total: 270-218 (55.3%), a winner in every season including each of the last 3. Caution: we wrote the test as 'bet the under', saw it lose, and flipped it, and it was one of ~20 ideas checked, so it may be luck. A live 0.5u test since Nov 11 2026 (owner's call)

setups.name: Fade the Sim
setups.why: Our simulator likes a side by 2+ points, but the morning market model (built on what was known by 11am: ratings, rest and travel, form, the line and the books) leans the other way: bet against the simulator, at the spread
setups.note: Each season predicted by a model trained only on earlier seasons, at the closing line: 2022-23 112-101, 2023-24 123-97, 2024-25 109-93, then 109-89 (55.1%) in the 2025-26 exam. Honest ~54%: 1 star, 0.5u in its first season
